from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one document, capturing company and relevant metrics."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as stated in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    other_payables_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of 其他应付款 if present in this document's balance sheet")
    other_payables_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
